stories.title: Airbus A350F freighter with Broughton-built wings makes first flight
stories.summary: A new Airbus cargo plane with wings built at Broughton has made its first flight. The first A350F freighter test aircraft took off from Toulouse on Tuesday 29 September and flew for four hours and 10 minutes, reaching 25,000 feet and a speed of 340 knots. Airbus said the wings for the A350F were assembled

stories.title: Restaurant, flats and smaller Post Office planned for The Highway in Ewloe
stories.summary: Ewloe Post Office would be reduced in size to make room for a restaurant, with three flats created in the rest of the building, under plans submitted to Flintshire Council. stories.title: North Wales health board must find £17m more savings to secure £108m from Welsh Government
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board is fighting to balance its books to secure £108 million of crucial extra central funding. Having already saved £46m this year however, if the board can make an additional £17m of savings – taking it’s annual savings to £63m – it will break even, retaining an £82m additional funding stream

stories.title: Penyffordd community garden paths resurfaced in £8,500 revamp
stories.summary: Potholed paths at a community garden in Penyffordd have been resurfaced and extended as part of an £8,500 revamp. The Millstone community garden and allotments have also gained raised beds, picnic benches and a commemorative tree.
